refactor: re-organize charts in the viewer code and minor improvements (#75)

Cleanup and re-organize the code for the Embedding Atlas view to a better structure, including:
- Move charts to a dedicated folder.
- Move layouts to a dedicated folder.
- Move utility functions to a separate "utils" module and a "utils" folder, and separate them into files.

Let the root view own the chart states, instead of individual charts own their states and "sync" with the root view.

feat: add viewport-dependent density-based downsampling (#118)

Add GPU-accelerated viewport-dependent downsampling to the point cloud renderer. When rendering large datasets, the system automatically reduces the number of rendered points while preserving visual fidelity by biasing the sampling toward dense regions. This unlocks a much higher upper bound for the size of datasets the viewer can work with, in practice.

See https://github.com/apple/embedding-atlas/pull/118 for more details.
